title: Mango Wobble
description: A rubbery FM sine bass whose timbre bounces between round and growly as the fm index travels on a slow 24-cycle LFO — tropical, playful, and locked to the dembow pocket. Over 28 cycles, harmonicity steps through off-ratio intervals for metallic sweetness, the ladder filter wobbles rhythmically on a prime-11 clock, and a stepped fm-index pattern ratchets the growl while pan and shape drift on 7 and 17-cycle sines — never settling, always sunny.
code:
setcpm(100/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 eb1 c1 c1 g0 c1 bb0>/2")
    .s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(24).range(1.5, 9).add("<0 2 4 1 3 0 5 2>/7"))
    .fmh("<1 1.5 2.01 0.5 3.99 1 2.5 0.75>/5")
    .penv("<3 0 5 0 7 0 3 2>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.06)
    .lpf(sine.slow(11).range(280, 1800)).resonance(sine.slow(13).range(4, 14)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv("<2 1 4 1>/4").lpattack(0.003).lpdecay(0.18)
    .vib("<0 0 0.4 0 0.6>/7").vibmod(sine.slow(17).range(0.1, 0.8))
    .shape(sine.slow(17).range(0.15, 0.42))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.3, 0.7))
    .attack(0.005).decay(0.22).sustain(0.55).release(0.08)
    .ply("<1 1 1 2>/16")
    .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.22).pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.15, 0.85)))
    .room(0.12).delay("0.18:0.25:0.35").gain(0.88)
)
